messages:
maia: Kicking off canary deploy v3.4.1 to prod-east in the 22:00-23:00 UTC window. Deploy bot kicked the plan.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: service=web-api image=redwood/web-api:v3.4.1 canary=5 pods

sven: saw increased 5xx in staging earlier. holding until we validate metrics for 5m. please don't promote.

maia: Ack. We have alerting on 5xx but so far only single digits on canary. Waiting 3m for steady state.

lucy: quick sanity check — release notes mention upstream dependency bump to compression-lib v2.2. Could be latent connection errors.

maia: good catch. If errors spike we should follow backout runbook: ops/runbooks/backout-lane-v2.md (link) — pin to image v3.4.0 and abort rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary error_rate trip: +2.3% over baseline at 4m mark. Threshold 2%.

sven: Hold and prepare backout. @lucy can you stage the rollback steps? I'll coordinate comms.

lucy: On it. Proposed rollback commands to pin image:
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/web-api web-api=redwood/web-api:v3.4.0 --record
kubectl rollout status deploy/web-api -n prod
```
Also prepping postmortem template and rollback note for release notes.

ops-runbook-bot: Referenced runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/backout-lane-v2 — sections: detect->decide->execute->verify. Recommended steps: drain canary, pin image, scale replicas, notify customers.

maia: agree. add step: revoke canary traffic routing via envoy weight split -> set web-api weight 0 for canary subset.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic set to 0% for subset id=canary-2026-06-01

lucy: Running pin now.

deploy-bot: Command executed: set image to redwood/web-api:v3.4.0 on 5 pods. Rollout in progress.

lucy: Rollout succeeded on all replicas, health checks passing.

sven: Notifying #prod-incidents and sending short release note update: 'Canary for v3.4.1 reverted due to elevated 5xx; investigating compression-lib upgrade.'

maia: Opening an investigation ticket and attaching perf traces + correlation IDs.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed. status=rolled_back, previous_tag=v3.4.0, incident_ticket=RN-4821

lucy: Leaving notes in runbook: cause likely compression-lib handshake regression on TLS. Will run canary again after patch or pin dependency.

sven: Thanks everyone. Postmortem + next steps in 24h. :thumbsup:
